review_basis:
Fifteenth golden, a fresh, previously-untouched project this session (`084_SC_H59_N054_FW_Building_112_Chiller_Addition.pdf`, a small 13-sheet chiller-addition set with only two mechanical/piping sheets carrying a detected scale, MP101 and MP102). Found via the text-anchored method: a size/system regex scan of MP101's own real text surfaced a `6" CHWS` / `6" CHWR (BELOW)` pair, and a render crop showed a real 'PIPE BELOW GRADE' detail -- an underground chilled-water pipe run drawn as ONE double-line symbol representing a stacked CHWS-over-CHWR pair (explicitly disclosed by the sheet's own '(BELOW)' annotation, a real, common convention for underground utility pairs drawn coincident in plan view), running from a real wall penetration (two green valve symbols) to a second real valve pair partway along the run.

`trace_run` reaches this segment cleanly and consistently across multiple seed positions (7.99 LF, matching the visible span between the two valve symbol pairs) with both ends `ambiguous` at the two real valve locations, confirmed via a marked render crop. This file's own `sheetInfo` reports empty `layers` on every mechanical sheet (the same file-wide missing-PDF-layer-names cause already established on the NAVFAC Cherry Point project this session), which drives the same `stroke-family:unclassified`/`size_missing`/`confidence:0` outcome seen there -- a manual size override is used, consistent with that same established precedent. Because the sheet's own label explicitly discloses TWO stacked pipes sharing this one drawn line (not a single system, unlike every other golden this session), this golden captures BOTH as separate runs sharing the identical verts_norm -- a real, disclosed departure from the usual one-line-one-run convention, matching what an actual takeoff would need to count from this drawing (both a 6-inch CHWS run and a 6-inch CHWR run of the same length). The run's own bench-style reseed (40% into its single segment) was independently re-verified live and reproduces the identical result.
scope: A real 6-inch chilled-water supply/return (CHWS/CHWR) underground pipe pair (7.99 LF each, drawn as one stacked double-line symbol per the sheet's own 'PIPE BELOW GRADE' / '(BELOW)' convention) on a Building 112 chiller-addition project's own piping plan, sheet MP101, from a real wall-penetration valve pair to a second real valve pair partway along the run. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the pipe's own continuation past the second valve pair into the chiller/heat-exchanger connection shown further right in the same crop; the vertical wall-penetration risers at the near end; every other run on this real 13-sheet plan set (only sheet 10/MP101 sampled); sheet MP102 (1/2" scale, no size/system text hits found on this pass).
